facts.fact: The report says the national open data portal opendata.go.tz, launched in September 2015 and managed by the eGovernment Agency, held 163 datasets (755 resources) from 11 institutions in 4 sectors by June 2017, double the year before, under the Chief Secretary's January 2015 circular as the interim directive.
